Machine-readable source of truth for plans/022-Release-0-2-2-Concurrent-State-and-Durability-Integrity.md: the four 0.2.2 implementation items (atomic model-budget reservation; atomic conversation metadata version/CAS; single-consumer + restart-stable durable identity + bounded active-run registries; multi-process state conformance) each with task ownership and evidence tokens, the compat policy (additive-only at 0.2.2 — reviewed plain gate deltas: version literal, PERSISTENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION 7->8, EVENT_MULTIPLEXER_SINGLE_CONSUMER_CODE/EventMultiplexerError, ModelRouterStateStore reserveBudget/commitBudget/releaseBudget + ModelRouterReservation + reservationTtlMs + maxRateKeys/maxBudgetKeys, SessionRecord.version + appendSession expectedVersion, buildMigration008Ddl/MIGRATION_008_SESSION_VERSION/buildEnterpriseMigration003Ddl, ActiveWorkflowRun.startedAt + ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_RUNS_OVERFLOW_CODE/MAX_ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_RUNS/sweepActiveWorkflowRuns, ./testing/state-concurrency-conformance subpath — no removal; baselines regenerated with --update-baseline, no --allow-break), the protected-gate policy (durable state-concurrency legs and NATS restart-durable resume are protected evidence, never passing skips; missing protected env records 0.2.2 as blocked), per-task evidence tokens, and the deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json. Baseline evidence for the Task 6 exit gate lives in scripts/phase22-baseline.json (captured at 0.2.1, completed at the 0.2.2 release state).
baseline: 0.2.1 (plan 021 exit gate passed 2026-08-13; signed tag v0.2.1; 50 publishable manifests; audit 0; compat baselines current at 0.2.1; four confirmed race windows: model-router readBudget/consumeRate/addUsage admission can collectively oversubscribe, conversation create/branch/archive read-modify-write can lose updates and resurrect stale archives, EventMultiplexer parks a second subscriber on one queue silently losing events, NATS durableName carries a random suffix so cursor resume does not survive restart; active-run registries unbounded; HEAD 7aa4684)

items.title: Atomic model-budget reservation (reserve/commit/release) + rate/budget/circuit cap and eviction
items.evidence: reserveBudget/commitBudget/releaseBudget on memory (packages/model-router/src/state.ts) and durable (packages/enterprise-postgres/src/model-router.ts) stores; ModelRouterReservation {reservationId, fencingToken}; ModelRouterBudgets.reservationTtlMs default 60000 bounded 31 days; maxRateKeys/maxBudgetKeys default 4096 hard 65536 (circuits unchanged 1024/16384); admission rewired to reserve-at-admission with commit/release at outcome (readBudget/addUsage stay for cap-less requests and retrospective accounting); LRU eviction never drops held-reservation rows (capacity-exhausted fail-closed); durable reservations JSONB column via migration 003; TTL-expired late commit charges reserved with unknownUsage true; router tests 24/24, enterprise-postgres 31/31, shared runEnterpriseStoreConformance reservation probes

items.title: Atomic conversation metadata updates (version/CAS) without lost updates or stale archive resurrection
items.evidence: SessionRecord.version (fresh rows start 1) + appendSession expectedVersion (0 create-only, N>0 exact-CAS update-only, omitted legacy last-write-wins); SessionMetadataConflictError metadata_conflict carrying {id, expectedVersion, currentVersion} only, HTTP 409; single-statement INSERT...SELECT...WHERE EXISTS...ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE WHERE version=expectedVersion AND ownership guards; branch cap enforced inside the CAS write; archive wins over stale writers; retention-deleted rows never resurrected (EXISTS guard); ConversationThread.version projected; migration 008 (PERSISTENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION 8) both stores; sqlite-persistence 21/21, server conversations 16/16, postgres integration 16/16

items.title: Single-consumer EventMultiplexer enforcement
items.evidence: activeConsumer flag inside subscribe() generator body; second concurrent subscriber throws EventMultiplexerError ERR_PRISM_EVENT_MULTIPLEXER_SINGLE_CONSUMER; slot frees on completion/return-at-yield/close (close also clears the flag for parked consumers); doc comment documents the parked-return caveat; tests in checkpoint-event-primitives.test.ts; in-repo consumers (workflow bus, supervisor) already single-subscriber

items.title: Restart-stable NATS durable consumer identity
items.evidence: durableName exactly prism_<hmac16 of tenantId|sessionId|runId> (random suffix removed); addConsumer is add-or-reuse (JetStreamApiError 10058 swallowed) so a crash-resumed subscribe continues from the last ack; durable consumer deleted in the generator finally on clean stop (cursor resume); orphaned 0.2.1 prism_<digest>_<random> consumers reclaimed via deleteConsumer/enumeration; pre-existing close() hang fixed with per-subscriber source-owned stop AbortControllers; event-source tests 13/13

items.title: Bounded, documented non-durable active-run registries (workflows)
items.evidence: MAX_ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_RUNS 512 non-configurable module constant; sweepActiveWorkflowRuns removes ALL aborted/leaked entries before the cap check on register; at cap with all-live entries register throws WorkflowRuntimeError ERR_PRISM_WORKFLOW_RUN_REGISTRY_OVERFLOW (never FIFO-evicts a live entry); startedAt recorded per entry; no timer/background service; docs/workflows.md non-durability statement; active-runs tests 4/4

deviations.change: plan's five scalar reservation columns became a single reservations JSONB column (migration 003 ALTER TABLE prism_model_router_budgets ADD COLUMN reservations JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')
deviations.rationale: A single-slot row cannot hold N concurrent reservations (acceptance requires N-1 concurrent reservations on one key and memory/durable agreement); migration 001's checksum is already recorded in released 0.2.1 databases so 001 cannot be edited

deviations.change: fencingToken is a randomUUID (unforgeable per reservation) instead of a monotonic numeric counter
deviations.rationale: Satisfies the reject-stale-committers intent; monotonic counters are not needed and would require per-key state

deviations.change: fresh session rows start at version 1 (not 0) and migration 008 backfills legacy version-0 rows to 1
deviations.rationale: Keeps 'version 0' unambiguous as the create-only sentinel (expectedVersion 0 = no update arm)

deviations.change: the unknown-outcome probe runs only against the memory store with injectable now; the durable TTL leg stays in the Task 1 integration probe with a real 25ms sleep
deviations.rationale: The durable store computes expiry from clock_timestamp() so expiry is not injectable and a deterministic no-sleep durable probe is impossible (1ms TTL needs >=1ms wall time, flaky over localhost)

deviations.change: sqlite harness leg runs ungated in the default workspace npm test instead of test:postgres
deviations.rationale: sqlite has no test:postgres script (filename ':memory:' serves as the memory leg)

deviations.change: scripts/phase22-conformance.test.mjs BLOCKED-gate branch fires only when the script runs standalone; in the test:postgres chain require-postgres-url.mjs fails first
the NATS seam is re-implemented structurally in-script (publish/subjects/fetch/acks) rather than importing FakeJetStream
deviations.rationale: FakeJetStream lives under src/__tests__/ and is not a public export; the script must import only public package entrypoints
